summary: Keep successful stay observations and failure metadata available through MCP and explicit delivery sinks when coverage is partial.
reason: A nonzero partial-result exit must retain observed data while preserving the failure signal; generic success-only output routing otherwise discards useful accommodation evidence.
markers: Stay exit 8 carries successful observations plus failed fetches.
validated_outcome: Real subprocess MCP tests preserve exit-8 data plus error state, including bounded oversize behavior. Execute-level file/webhook tests preserve partial envelopes and exit 8, prohibit failure-only delivery, and report one actionable sink-failure diagnostic.
